name: Sandy Beach County Park
evidence: satellite at 43.4968,-85.6302: the county's 'Full-hookup, Pull-thru, Water View' pads (Firefly/county rates) sit ~15-20 m from Hardy Dam Pond behind the pull-thru exit lane and a thin tree/brush fringe on a bank ~5 m above pool (DEM 255 vs 250), upstream of the dam; wooded N loops behind a vegetated bank. View, not frontage

name: Stafford County Park
evidence: Huron Co park map (rev 1/24) + satellite at 43.9458,-82.7104: only shore sites are rustic 3-10, which Checkfront lists as 'tent only'; 'Lake View' electric sites 1-11 sit W of the loop drive with Pavilion 1 lawn between them and the rocky shore; full hookups inland across Huron St

name: Silver Lake State Park Campground
evidence: --AWH firsthand: sites 1-13 adjacent to Silver Lake but separated by the driveway; satellite at 43.6624,-86.4963 shows the lakeside row ~15-20 m back under trees, nothing contradicting it. Booking 'Adjacent To: Waterfront' tag is weak

name: Sunset Cove Resort
evidence: operator rates page sells nightly 'Lakefront' full-hookup sites ($50); operator lot map + satellite at 41.9280,-84.8955 and 41.9262,-84.8950: RV lots (55-99 loop, cove frontage by docks 1-4) at Marble Lake's edge, pads within ~10 m of the water

name: Wolverine Campground
evidence: Genesee Co 2026 site map: Lakefront sites 1-21 (50A) and 127-155 (30A) on Holloway Reservoir shore/inlet; satellite at 43.1198,-83.4634: peninsula pads with RVs ~10-15 m from the water across open grass. Old pin was on the W beach/day-use area ~450 m off

name: Bay Mills Casino - Sunrise RV Park
evidence: satellite at 46.4239,-84.6039: gravel pull-through rows W of the highway, ~150-250 m from Waiska Bay behind the road, a treeline and the casino/parking complex; 'overlooks the Back Bay' is marketing

name: Bay Ridge RV Park & Campground
evidence: satellite at 45.7866,-86.5690: lowest gravel pads ~40-60 m from the Garden Bay beach across a rough brushy slope, DEM ~200 m at pads vs ~174 at shore (on a bluff/slope); '400 ft of waterfront' is the property/boat slips, not pads

name: Big Lake Campground
evidence: satellite at 46.2489,-85.7224: lakefront-lot RVs ~15 m from the Big Manistique Lake sand beach across open unused lawn, no road or screen; operator photo (2013, biglakecurtis.wordpress.com) shows site posts on open lawn at the shore
